description: Remove provenance filter UI from the frontend Corpus Browser (IntelligenceSearch.jsx) and remove the provenance query parameter handling from the backend /api/ir/corpus endpoint (ir_routes.py). Keep provenance badges in search result cards (EvidenceCard and WhyPanel) unchanged — only remove them from the Corpus Browser. This feature is independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Frontend changes in routeOptimiserFrontend/src/pages/IntelligenceSearch.jsx, CorpusBrowser component: (a) Remove the provF state variable and setProvF setter (line ~570), (b) Remove the PROVS constant array (line ~576), (c) Remove the provenance <select> dropdown from the filter row (line ~583), (d) Remove params.set('provenance', provF) from the fetch call (line ~581), (e) Remove the provenance <Badge> from the collapsed document row header (line ~605, inside the button), (f) Keep the provenance <Badge> in the expanded document details section (line ~620, this shows document metadata and should remain).

2. Frontend: Do NOT remove provenance badges from EvidenceCard component (used for search results) or WhyPanel component (the 'Why ranked #N?' modal) — these components display search results, not the corpus browser, and their provenance badges should remain.
3. Frontend: Do NOT remove the PROV_BADGE constant (it is still used by EvidenceCard and WhyPanel).

4. Backend changes in routeOptimiserBackend/src/api/ir_routes.py, corpus_browser() function: (a) Remove the line provenance = (request.args.get('provenance') or '').upper() (line ~216), (b) Remove the conditional filter block if provenance: docs = [d for d in docs if d.provenance == provenance] (line ~220), (c) Keep hazard, state, and severity filters unchanged.
5. Verify the frontend still compiles and the Corpus Browser filter row shows only hazard (dropdown), state (text input), and severity (if it exists) — no provenance dropdown.
6. Verify the backend /api/ir/corpus endpoint still accepts ?hazard=flood&state=Assam&severity=high but ignores ?provenance=LIVE if passed (no error, just no filtering).
acceptance_criteria: Frontend Corpus Browser filter row has no provenance dropdown selector
Frontend Corpus Browser collapsed document rows (the clickable header) have no provenance badge
Frontend Corpus Browser expanded document details still show provenance badge (in the metadata section with other document fields)
Frontend EvidenceCard component (search results) still shows provenance badges — unchanged
Frontend WhyPanel component ('Why ranked #N?' modal) still shows provenance badges — unchanged
Backend /api/ir/corpus endpoint no longer filters by provenance query parameter
GET /api/ir/corpus?hazard=flood returns flood documents without error
GET /api/ir/corpus?provenance=LIVE does not filter (returns all documents, ignores the parameter)
npm run build succeeds for the frontend
python -m pytest passes for the backend
verification: cd routeOptimiserFrontend && npm run build (ensure no build errors)
cd routeOptimiserBackend && python -m pytest -xvs (all tests pass)
Manual check: start backend with python main.py, open Corpus Browser in frontend, confirm no provenance dropdown in filter row, confirm provenance badge still visible in expanded document details
